requests.topic: Year-end function photos in Joburg: how to plan your shoot
requests.notes:
Corporate and club year-ends peak from late November to mid December, and organisers search for a photographer in the last few weeks.
Show event and party frames from past FOM functions and walk planners through what a 2 hour photo or photo and video booking covers.
Outline: Why year-end photos matter for your team and socials; Photo, video or both: picking the right package; A simple shot list: arrivals, speeches, awards, dance floor; Lighting tips for evening venues; Book your December date

requests.topic: A photoshoot as a Christmas gift (and Black Friday 15% off)
requests.notes:
Black Friday is 27 Nov and FOM runs 15% off shoots booked 27 to 30 Nov, while people hunt for experience gifts before Christmas.
Gift ideas by person (couple, parent, car lover, sporty friend) with a matching package, plus how the Black Friday code works.
Outline: Why a shoot beats another gift card; Which package suits who: Mini Shoot to Photo and Video; How the FOMBLACKFRIDAY 15% off works (27 to 30 Nov); Picking a date later is fine; How to book or gift it

requests.topic: Festive market season: product photos and reels for small brands
requests.notes:
Joburg's festive markets run back to back (KAMERS/Makers Sandton 24 to 29 Nov, Linden Market Festive Edition 28 to 29 Nov, Rosebank Sunday Market 29 Nov), and vendors need fresh content for December sales.
Practical guide for makers and food vendors on getting product shots and a short reel that sell before and after a market weekend.
Outline: Why markets are the perfect time for new content; Product photos vs a short reel: what to get; Shooting your stall: setup, prep and first customer; Turning one shoot into a month of posts; Book a Mini Shoot or product session
